**Least-connections tie-breaking**

The current tie-breaking in least-connections routing is wrong. When multiple endpoints share the same active-connection count, they should be preferred by weight (higher weight wins), not just by address order. Keep lexicographic address as the secondary tie-breaker (i.e., weight first, then address). Update the selection logic accordingly.

When connection_limit_mode is per-service, max_connections_per_endpoint caps total active connections across all endpoints combined
data-store service is configured with per-service mode and max_connections_per_endpoint=3, allowing at most 3 total connections
connection_limit_mode is reloadable via SIGHUP
get_service IPC response includes the current connection_limit_mode for the service
EndpointConfig has a warmup_duration_ms integer field (default 0, 0=disabled)
When an endpoint transitions from unhealthy or unknown to healthy (health check recovery or reset_circuit_breaker), a warm-up timer starts for warmup_duration_ms
During warm-up, effective weight is floor(0.25 * configured_weight) with a minimum of 1
After warm-up timer expires, effective weight becomes the full configured weight instantly
Endpoint remains eligible for routing during warm-up; only its weight is reduced
